{# Tera components. Zola 0.23 (Tera2) replaced both macros and shortcodes with this one mechanism: a component is defined in any template file, is visible everywhere without an import, and is callable from templates *and* from markdown content. Components are hygienic — they see their parameters and nothing else, so everything a component needs is an explicit argument. #} {# Sidebar navigation. docs_section — the section whose .pages become the nav entries current_permalink — permalink of the page to mark active, or "" for none current_toc — that page's `toc`, expanded under the active entry The active page arrives as its two fields rather than as the page itself: a component parameter takes its type from its default, so one that has to accept both a page and a "no active page" sentinel has no usable default. #} {% component toc_nav(docs_section, current_permalink="", current_toc=[]) %}

{{ page_group }}
{% set_global current_group = page_group %} {% endif %}
{{ doc_page.title }}

{{ child.title }}
